_README: ⚠️ Derived from sources.db, NOT from the network, so this one CAN be rebuilt. It is committed anyway because sources.db is 5.18 GB and gitignored, so a fresh clone cannot derive it without refetching 5 GB. build_library.py rebuilds it when sources.db is present and falls back to this file when it is not.
_what: The Open Food Facts ingredients-taxonomy tree. `parents` maps an OFF entry id to the parent slugs it names. `children` counts how many entries name each parent.
_caveat: ⚠️ CHILD COUNT RANKS CATEGORIES AND CANNOT DECIDE THEM. en:cheese has 86 children, en:fruit 78, en:honey 44, en:rice 34. They are categories AND ingredients. Cutting on child count loses cheese, honey and rice.
